title: fix(plugin-chatbot): name an over-size attachment and the limit to the user instead of only console.warn
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg48yiCyRmnqoUoHcQ9VbBp6)_
Fixes #34463

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The two widenings are additive: the new key `chatbot.composer.fileTooLarge` in every locale pack `@object-ui/i18n` publishes through `./locales`, and the optional `files` field on the `onError` argument of `PromptInputProps`, exported as `AIElements` from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:聊天输入框里超过大小上限的文件,现在会在输入框上方显示一条提示,写明文件名和上限(按用户语言,11 种语言都有);一次选多个文件时,小文件照常附上,超限的逐个点名。
- 为什么改:以前超限文件只进 `console.warn`,用户看到的是文件「没附上」却不知道原因;一次选了大小混合的文件时,大文件连 `console.warn` 都没有。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,只动前端提示和 `onError` 的上报时机(混合选择多报一次,多带一个可选的 `files` 字段);回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/prompt-input.tsx`(`addLocal` 的超限分支);`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`(`handlePromptInputError` 与 `ComposerNotice`);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`(新键译文)。
- 两分钟验证:在仓根跑 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx`,预期 14 个测试全绿,其中 5 个是本卡新增的超限提示用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Producer** (`PromptInput`, vendored AI Elements): `addLocal` now reports EVERY over-size file of a pick through `onError({ code: 'max_file_size', files })`. Before, it reported only a pick where every file was over the limit; a mixed pick attached the small files and dropped the large ones with no report at all. The error object gains one optional field, `files?: File[]` (the refused files); `code` and `message` keep their meaning.
- **Consumer** (`ChatbotEnhanced`): the `onError` handler that only called `console.warn` now turns a `max_file_size` refusal into a notice above the composer, naming every refused file and the limit (`10 MB` by default, spelled by `Intl.NumberFormat` in the user's locale). It uses the band the chat already shows for an unsent message: `SendErrorNotice`'s markup is now a shared `ComposerNotice`, so both read the same. The notice closes with its close button or on the next send; a later refusal replaces it. Other codes still go to `console.warn` (see Acceptance notes).
- **Translation**: new pack key `chatbot.composer.fileTooLarge` (`{{limit}}`, `{{files}}`) in all eleven locale files under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`, next to the composer's existing `chatbot.composer.*` keys. The close button reuses `common.close`.
- Changeset: `.changeset/34463-composer-oversize-notice.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in `ChatbotEnhanced.sendError.test.tsx`, the composer-notice file, so no new harness file:

- over-size file alone: the notice (`role="alert"`) names the file and the limit, and the file is not attached;
- mixed pick: the small file attaches, the notice names only the large one;
- CONTROL: a file under the limit attaches with no notice;
- the close button dismisses the notice;
- under `zh`, the notice is the zh pack sentence and not the en one (read from the packs, not from literals).

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and verified as blob == HEAD)</summary>

- Producer: `if (oversized.length > 0) {` became `if (oversized.length > 0 && sized.length === 0) {` (the old mixed-pick silence). Result: `× a mixed pick attaches the file under the limit and names only the one over it`, `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed | 9 skipped (14)`. Restored: `blob == HEAD (5d03375a8c39) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- Consumer: `if (e.code === 'max_file_size' && e.files?.length) {` changed so it never matches (the old `console.warn`-only handler). Result: the over-size, mixed, close and zh cases fail, CONTROL passes, `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed | 9 skipped (14)`. Restored: `blob == HEAD (de5e3f172a98)`.

The test imports `../ChatbotEnhanced` from source, so no `dist` rebuild was needed for either leg.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck, at head a4b0e496</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/ --maxWorkers=2` exited 0: `Test Files 207 passed (207)`, `Tests 3006 passed | 13 skipped (3019)`. The i18n locale gates (key parity across all locales, glyph and quote rules) are in this run.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/ --maxWorkers=2` exited 0: `Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped (173)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` exited 0, and so did `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`. Both run `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The `accept` and `max_files` codes.** `accept` has the same shape as the bug this PR fixes: it reports only a pick where every file fails the type check, and drops a failing file from a mixed pick silently. Its fix is in other lines of `addLocal`, so it stays out of this PR. A separate, larger defect sits under it, and the agent's report hands it to the seat as a finding instead of fixing it here: `matchesAccept` compares each `accept` token with `File.type`, so extension tokens (`.pdf`, `.csv`, `.xlsx` …) never match. A probe render of `ChatbotEnhanced` (`enableFileUpload`, default `acceptedFileTypes`) picked `claims.csv` (`text/csv`), then `r.pdf` (`application/pdf`), then `ok.png`. The two warnings were `["accept","accept"]`: the csv and the pdf did not attach, and only the png did. `ChatbotEnhanced` passes no `maxFiles`, so `max_files` never fires in this composer. Both codes still reach only `console.warn` here; making them visible needs their own wording and the `matchesAccept` fix first.
- **Provider mode is not checked.** `PromptInputProvider`'s `add()` applies neither `accept` nor `maxFileSize`. `ChatbotEnhanced` does not mount a provider, so nothing reaches this today.
- **Published declaration surface (measured on the built `dist`).** The new key appears in all eleven `dist/locales/*.d.ts` of `@object-ui/i18n`, which the package publishes through its `./locales` export: as a `readonly` literal in `en`, `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant`, and as `string` in the others. `PromptInputProps['onError']` gains the optional `files` field. It is exported as `AIElements` from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`. Both are additive. The seat ruled them `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, and the declaration lines above and in the changeset say so.
- **The size unit.** The limit is a binary size (`10 * 1024 * 1024`), shown with the locale's `megabyte` unit label as `10 MB`. That matches how the composer's default has always been described.

## Verification

- Local derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` named 41 commands at head `a4b0e496`, and all 41 exited 0. Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 41 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 41 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exited 0.
- CI runs the full set, including `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` and the type-check lanes.
- Not measured in a live browser. The behaviour is pinned at the component level in jsdom.
